About This 2018 Chevrolet Express 3500 Cargo Van The 2018 Chevrolet Express 3500 is the full-size, heavy-duty workhorse of the Express lineup — and the Extended Van configuration gives you the maximum cargo-hauling capacity GM offers in this platform. At 171,049 miles, this van has clearly seen real-world use, which is exactly what the Express 3500 was engineered for. Commercial-grade vans like this one are built to a different standard than passenger vehicles, with heavy-duty suspensions, reinforced frames, and drivetrains designed for high-mileage, high-load duty cycles. For buyers running a trade, managing a fleet, or hauling equipment across Wayne County and beyond, a well-maintained high-mileage Express 3500 can deliver years of continued reliable service at a fraction of the cost of a new unit.
2018 Chevrolet Express 3500 Performance and Engine Under the hood sits GM's legendary 6.0-liter Flex Fuel V8, paired with a heavy-duty 6-speed automatic transmission with overdrive. This is not a light-duty engine stuffed into a big body — the 6.0L V8 in the Express 3500 is purpose-built to handle serious payload and towing demands day after day. Flex Fuel capability means this van can run on E85 ethanol, regular gasoline, or any blend in between, giving fleet operators flexibility at the pump. The rear-wheel-drive configuration is standard for a cargo van of this class and contributes to the van's towing and payload capacity. The 6-speed HD automatic with overdrive keeps the engine in its power band under load while improving highway efficiency during long hauls between delivery stops or job sites.Chevrolet Express 3500 Features and Interior As a dedicated cargo van, the Express 3500 Extended is configured to maximize usable space rather than passenger comfort — and that's exactly the point. The extended body length provides a generous cargo area capable of handling large equipment, shelving builds, plumbing and electrical supplies, catering or food service equipment, and much more. The driver's area is workman-functional: clear sightlines, straightforward controls, and a commanding seating position that makes long days behind the wheel manageable. The 3500 series carries a higher GVWR than the 2500, making it the right choice for contractors and businesses that regularly push payload limits. Buyers frequently upfit these vans with ladder racks, partition walls, shelving systems, and tow packages — the Extended platform accommodates all of it.Chevrolet Express 3500 Reliability and Ownership The Chevrolet Express has been in continuous production since 1995, and for good reason — it works. The 6.0-liter Vortec V8 found in this van is one of the most reliable truck-based engines GM has ever produced. It's the same engine family used in Silverado HD pickups and is well-supported by independent shops and dealers nationwide. Owners and fleet managers consistently report that well-maintained Express vans reach 200,000 to 300,000 miles with routine service — oil changes, transmission fluid, spark plugs, and cooling system maintenance being the primary items to stay on top of. At 171,049 miles, this van is well into its working life but nowhere near the end of it if it's been properly cared for. Pre-purchase inspections by a trusted mechanic are always recommended on high-mileage commercial vehicles, and any reputable seller will welcome that request.Why Buy From Turbo Motors? Turbo Motors is located in Taylor, in Wayne County, Michigan — right in the heart of Downriver, where working people and business owners know the value of a dollar. At Turbo Motors, the inventory reflects that understanding: practical, capable vehicles priced for real buyers, not for show. Whether you're a solo contractor looking to replace an aging van, a small business adding to your fleet, or an operator searching for a capable hauler at a working-person's price point, Turbo Motors is the kind of independent dealership that gets it. No high-pressure tactics, no inflated markups — just solid vehicles and straightforward deals. Give them a call at (734) 307-1169 to confirm availability and schedule a time to come take a look.

description: The 2023 BMW M5 Sedan 4D offers an exhilarating driving experience wrapped in a striking Blue Ridge Mountain Metallic exterior and a sophisticated white interior. With 39,240 miles on the odometer, this used luxury sports sedan combines performance and technology, making it a compelling choice for enthusiasts seeking both power and comfort. Its 4.4-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine delivers a formidable 600 horsepower and 553 lb-ft of torque, paired with an 8-speed M Sport automatic transmission with Drivelogic for seamless shifts and dynamic driving modes. The all-wheel drive system ensures confident handling, whether you're cruising on highways or carving corners. Inside, this M5 is packed with features to enhance every journey. Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, and satellite radio keep you connected, while the premium audio system with 14 speakers delivers immersive sound. The large 12.3-inch infotainment screen offers navigation, HD radio, and voice-activated controls, complemented by a head-up display for easy access to vital information. Comfort is prioritized with heated leather seats, memory functions, and interior accents that elevate the cabin’s ambiance. Convenience features include a hands-free liftgate, wireless phone charging, keyless entry, rear A/C, and a WiFi hotspot. Safety and driver assistance are well-represented with a backup camera, blind spot monitor, collision warning, lane keep assist, cross traffic alert, and a heads-up display, ensuring peace of mind during every drive. 2023 BMW M5 Safety and Security Features This M5 includes dual front knee airbags for enhanced occupant protection, along with traffic sign recognition that helps keep you aware of road conditions. Premium brakes and ABS-equipped four-wheel system provide reliable stopping power, while parking sensors at the front and rear assist with precise maneuvering. A regenerative braking system improves efficiency, and interior motion sensors plus anti-tow devices bolster security. Emergency braking preparation ensures quick response in critical moments, making this vehicle as safe as it is powerful. 2023 BMW M5 Entertainment and Technology Features The M5’s entertainment system is built for connectivity and immersive sound. It features a 12.3-inch infotainment screen paired with 14 speakers, including a subwoofer, delivering a surround sound experience in 5.1. BMW ConnectedDrive compatibility allows for remote app functions like engine start and cabin preconditioning, while smart device app features enable using your phone as a key and voice-activated radio and phone calls. The system’s HD radio and BMW’s comprehensive infotainment suite make every drive enjoyable and connected. 2023 BMW M5 Performance Features Performance is at the core of this M5, equipped with an active suspension system that adapts to driving conditions. Auto start/stop and electronic suspension control help optimize efficiency and ride comfort, while driver-adjustable ride control allows personalization. The locking rear differential and sport-tuned suspension enhance handling, especially in aggressive driving scenarios. With full-time four-wheel drive, this sedan offers exceptional grip and stability, ensuring that power is delivered confidently in all conditions.

More than a dealership, we're part of the Louisville community and proud to support our neighbors. Whether you're shopping for a new vehicle or need trusted service, we're here to make your experience smooth, affordable, and personalized every step of the way. When you choose from our pre-owned inventory, such as this Solar Silver Metallic 2024 Honda Accord Hybrid Touring with 2,428 miles, you are not just buying a pre-owned vehicle... you're getting confidence and peace of mind! Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service! Take this 2024 Honda Accord Hybrid Touring for instance... No Accidents! One Owner! What this vehicle includes: Convenience
  • Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead. It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again. Distance pacing cruise control with traffic stop-go, your ultimate co-pilot.
Safety and Security
  • Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down, speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control.
  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Lane departure prevention - Keep it between the lines. It only takes a moment of inattention for your vehicle to drift. With lane departure prevention, your vehicle takes corrective action to help you avoid unintentionally moving out of your lane. Lane departure prevention is an extra level of safety for you and those around you.
  • Head-up display - Keep your head up! You don't have to take your eyes off of the road to get information from your dashboard anymore. With head-up display, important driving information - like speed and RPM's - displays on your windshield in your line of sight. Because when you're driving, the most important information lies on the road ahead. Keep your eyes on the road with head-up display.
  • Brake assist - Stop right there. Something jumps out into the middle of the road and you need to stop now! With brake assist, you will. It uses the speed of the brake pedal's travel to sense panic braking, then applies all available power to boost your stopping power. Brake assist can stop the accident before it is one.
Technology and Telematics
  • Apple CarPlay/Android Auto smart device wireless mirroring
  • Mobile hotspot - WiFi on the fly. Connect your devices to the Internet through your vehicle's private mobile hotspot and take the internet wherever your journey takes you, without eating up your data allowance. Find the hotspot with mobile hotspot.

Audi Marin is delighted to showcase this Pre-Owned 2021 Audi A6 55 TFSI quattro. Finished in a sophisticated Carat Beige Metallic exterior and complemented by a luxurious Pearl Beige interior, this executive sedan is a showcase of Audi's commitment to premium craftsmanship, innovative technology, and exhilarating performance.
Elegantly styled with the distinctive S line Exterior, HD Matrix-design LED headlights, and flowing body lines, this A6 commands attention while delivering the refined driving dynamics Audi is renowned for. Equipped with both the Prestige Package and Luxury Package, this sedan offers a first-class driving experience from every seat.

Step inside and discover an impeccably appointed cabin featuring Valcona/Milano leather seating, Individual Contour Front Seats with ventilation, massage, and memory, along with an Extended Leather Package that wraps the dashboard, armrests, and center console in premium materials. The Bang & Olufsen Premium 3D Sound System, Audi Virtual Cockpit, Head-Up Display, and MMI Navigation Plus combine to create an immersive, technology-rich environment, while dual-pane acoustic glass and soft-closing doors elevate every drive in exceptional comfort.

Engine and Performance: Beneath the hood lies a powerful 3.0-liter TFSI turbocharged V6 engine, producing an impressive 335 horsepower and 369 lb-ft of torque. Paired with Audi's lightning-fast 7-speed S tronic dual-clutch transmission and legendary quattro all-wheel drive system, the A6 delivers effortless acceleration, exceptional handling, and confidence in every season. Adaptive Cruise Assist with Active Lane Assist and Audi Drive Select further enhance both performance and long-distance comfort.

Key Features:

Prestige Package: Includes HD Matrix-design LED Headlights, Head-Up Display, Audi Virtual Cockpit, Bang & Olufsen Premium 3D Sound System, Top View Camera System, Power Soft-Closing Doors, Heated Steering Wheel, Traffic Sign Recognition, Adaptive Cruise Assist with Active Lane Assist, and Dual Pane Acoustic Glass.

Luxury Package: Features Individual Contour Front Seats with ventilation and massage, Valcona/Milano Leather Seating, and the Extended Leather Package throughout the cabin.

Audi Beam Rings: Projects the iconic Audi rings onto the ground when entering or exiting the vehicle for an elegant finishing touch.

Head-Up Display: Keeps important driving information directly within your line of sight for added confidence behind the wheel.

Bang & Olufsen Premium 3D Sound System: Delivers exceptional audio clarity with immersive three-dimensional sound throughout the cabin.

Power Soft-Closing Doors & Top View Camera System: Enhance convenience and provide effortless operation with premium luxury features.



Dealer Installed Items:

StarGard Vehicle Theft Recovery System: Provides advanced theft recovery technology and an added layer of security for enhanced peace of mind.

ClearShield Protection Package: Professionally applied protection designed to help preserve the vehicle's exterior finish and interior surfaces, helping maintain its exceptional appearance.

The 2021 Mercedes-Benz E-Class E 450 4MATIC Sedan 4D stands as the absolute mid-generation benchmark for executive luxury, showcasing a spectacular styling and technological refresh. Built on a rigid high-strength steel and aluminum intensive unibody frame, this highly prestigious model introduces a game-changing mild-hybrid powertrain that completely redefines traditional luxury propulsion. The E 450 functions as a commanding mobile boardroom during the demanding corporate workweek, effortlessly smoothing out tight urban grids and dominating open interstate routes with whisper-quiet prestige. It represents an uncompromised balance of executive comfort, athletic handling, and forward-thinking digital innovation that turns heads in any corporate layout.

Under the sculpted, aerodynamic hood sits an absolute masterpiece of modern German engineering: a highly responsive 3.0-liter inline 6-cylinder Turbocharged engine featuring an advanced 48-volt mild-hybrid EQ Boost electrical system. This high-output mechanical heart hammers out a fierce 362 horsepower and a robust, low-end 369 lb-ft of torque available at an exceptionally low 1,600 RPM. The EQ Boost system can instantly supply an additional 21 horsepower and 184 lb-ft of torque, completely eliminating turbo lag and driving an ultra-smooth engine start-stop functionality. This immediate muscle is managed by a lightning-fast, smooth-shifting 9G-TRONIC 9-speed automatic transmission with steering-wheel-mounted manual shift controls. Rocketing this all-wheel-drive luxury fortress from 0 to 60 mph in a swift, sports-car-rivaling 4.9 seconds, power is routed to the pavement via Mercedes intelligent 4MATIC permanent all-wheel-drive system, which actively calculates real-world wheel slip to dynamically distribute torque between the front and rear axles.

The driving experience is heavily characterized by its surgical handling precision, flat cornering posture, and unmatched structural stability under high-speed maneuvers, courtesy of a performance-tuned independent front and rear multi-link suspension network. On the exterior, the 2021 E 450 executes a stunning styling triumph of pure Euro-luxury functionality, highlighted by a redesigned, lower-slung front fascia anchored by a prominent chrome-accented grille layout, a sportier lower air intake array, and striking, restyled automatic LED High-Performance headlamps with signature daytime running lights. Elegant, wind-tunnel-carved body contours feature crisp aluminum window surrounds, a power tilt-and-slide glass sunroof, and aerodynamic power-folding heated side mirrors with memory, all rolling on striking 18-inch twin 5-spoke aluminum alloy wheels wrapped in high-performance all-season tires that perfectly accent its wide-track athletic stance. The refreshed rear profile is equipped with a clean trunk lines and newly designed, sleek horizontal geometric LED taillights that extend into the boot lid.

Inside, the driver-centric cockpit completely shuns basic, high-maintenance textures, welcoming up to five occupants into an opulent, ultra-durable luxury sanctuary lined with hand-tailored premium finishes, authentic natural wood inlay accents, and cutting-edge command tech. The center dashboard layout is dominated by a spectacular dual widescreen display network, seamlessly grouping a sharp 12.3-inch color touchscreen multimedia infotainment monitor powered by the advanced MBUX system with a matching 12.3-inch fully digital reconfigurable driver instrument cluster display. Elite digital connectivity is driven by built-in wireless Apple CarPlay and wireless Android Auto smartphone integration, allowing seamless phone syncing without messy cords cluttering the console area, along with a high-fidelity premium surround sound audio network. First-class executive touches include deeply cushioned comfort front bucket seats draped in premium, wear-resistant genuine leather upholstery featuring full power driver and passenger adjustments, heating elements, and performance driver memory blocks, all complemented by a newly designed capacitive-touch multifunction steering wheel and Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control.

Practicality and premium space utilization are handled with sleek executive efficiency, effortlessly matching the demands of an active lifestyle or professional business setup. Bypassing restrictive compact boundaries, the rear passenger section treats occupants to exceptional adult-sized legroom and headroom, while the power trunk opens wide to reveal a highly generous 13.1 cubic feet of flat cargo trunk space. Utilizing the quick-release 40/20/40 split-folding rear bench seatbacks, the interior layout allows you to easily transport professional media camera gear packages, large travel luggage sets, or commercial marketing inventory away from the elements. Bypassing the heavy consumption of older large-displacement engines, the highly optimized mild-hybrid inline-6 achieves an efficient, budget-friendly EPA-estimated 23 MPG city and 30 MPG highway, backed by a substantial 21.1-gallon fuel tank to yield an exceptional long-distance highway driving range of over 630 miles on a single fill-up.

Safety is world-class, utilizing an ultra-high-strength steel passenger safety cell with integrated energy-absorbing front and rear crumple zones to displace heavy impact forces, securing top-tier crash safety ratings. The 2021 model comes factory-equipped with a robust active driver protective safety shield, featuring standard active defensive items including Active Brake Assist for forward collision avoidance, Blind Spot Assist, and the comprehensive ATTENTION ASSIST driver drowsiness monitor. A high-resolution rearview backup camera with front and rear park assist sensors works invisibly alongside electronic stability control, traction control, anti-lock 4-wheel disc brakes with emergency brake assist, and an advanced multi-stage 9-airbag protection canopy network to guarantee absolute driving peace of mind through stressful daily city commutes or sudden severe highway downpours. Sleek Executive Silhouette. 362-HP EQ Boost Mild-Hybrid Inline-6 Core. Intelligent 4MATIC All-Wheel-Drive Precision. Widescreen Dual 12.3-Inch MBUX Touch Sanctuary. ??
